reasons.c.integration: c/Dockerfile.grpc, c/Makefile and the rust/Makefile gRPC targets changed, and the gRPC arm now builds with --all-features and the debug library.
reasons.c.unit: c/CMakeLists.txt, c/Makefile and every C test program changed: each now includes the new test_filter.h, which replaces RUN_TEST and UNITY_END, and they link the debug Rust library.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: dotnet/Dockerfile.grpc, Dockerfile.grpc.async, the csproj and the rust/Makefile gRPC targets changed.
reasons.dotnet.performance: The changed csproj and dotnet/Makefile reach the performance tests.
reasons.dotnet.soak: The changed csproj native copy and dotnet/Makefile reach the soak tests.
reasons.dotnet.solution: Confluent.Kafka.csproj changed how the native library is copied, dotnet/Makefile changed, and so did a unit test (PublicProducerControlOperationsTests).
reasons.python.grpc: python/Dockerfile.grpc, Dockerfile.grpc.async and the rust/Makefile gRPC targets changed.
reasons.python.integration: setup.py and python/Makefile changed how the extension is built and linked.
reasons.python.performance: python/Makefile and setup.py are build-file changes that reach this suite.
reasons.python.soak: python/Makefile and setup.py are build-file changes that reach this suite.
reasons.python.static: python/Makefile and setup.py are build-file changes that reach this suite.
reasons.python.typecheck: python/Makefile and setup.py changed, and the build-file rule says to include every Python suite they can reach.
reasons.python.unit: setup.py now links the debug Rust library by default, and python/Makefile changed.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: python/Makefile and setup.py are build-file changes that reach this suite.
reasons.rust.admin: rust/Cargo.toml adds a workspace-wide [profile.test], so every Rust test target is rebuilt with it, and rust/Makefile now runs every cargo test through the new xtask selection wrapper.
reasons.rust.chaos: Workspace build-file change: the new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml applies to this test target too.
reasons.rust.consumer: Workspace build-file change: the new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml and the rust/Makefile changes apply to this target.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: This workspace member is built with the changed test profile from rust/Cargo.toml.
reasons.rust.doc: Doctests are built under the changed Cargo.toml profiles.
reasons.rust.ffi-macros: This workspace member is built with the changed test profile from rust/Cargo.toml.
reasons.rust.generator: This workspace member is built with the changed test profile, and test-all-features now runs it through the changed Makefile wrapper.
reasons.rust.integration: rust/tests/integration and rust/tests/common changed, and so did the build profile and the Makefile's integration and gRPC targets.
reasons.rust.integrity: Workspace build-file change: the new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml applies to this test target too.
reasons.rust.lib: The lib unit tests are built with the new [profile.test] and run through the changed Makefile.
reasons.rust.multilanguage-test-server: This workspace member is built with the changed test profile from rust/Cargo.toml.
reasons.rust.performance: test-integration-perf now uses build-tests-all-features with --all-features and the new test profile.
reasons.rust.producer: Workspace build-file change: the new [profile.test] in rust/Cargo.toml and the rust/Makefile changes apply to this target.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: This workspace member is built with the changed test profile from rust/Cargo.toml.
reasons.rust.xtask: rust/xtask changed: its Cargo.toml, main.rs and java.rs, plus the new test_selection modules.
